thought: This is the opening establishing shot with a 7-second slow pan right across the Wolf Fang Mountain landscape. Since no reference images are provided and there are no characters in this scene, I'm creating 3 keyframes to ensure smooth camera movement: (1) Starting position (left side of landscape) using Text type to establish the visual foundation, (2) Middle position using Modify type to continue the pan, and (3) End position (right side) using Modify type to complete the pan. The prompts emphasize the realistic thick-painted 2D animation style with low-saturation earth tones, strong chiaroscuro, heavy oppressive atmosphere, and the key narrative element of distant villages with black smoke suggesting the approaching war.

keyframe_prompt.prompt: Wide establishing shot, vast mountain landscape of Shanxi-Chahar-Hebei border region, autumn 1941, beginning of rightward pan. Exposure: ISO 200, f/11, 1/125s, natural overcast daylight, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting with strong light-dark contrast. Composition: Elevated camera angle looking across rolling mountain ranges, rule of thirds with mountain ridges occupying middle and upper thirds, sky in upper third, foreground hills in lower third creating depth layers, camera framed to capture left portion of panoramic vista. Depth of Field: Deep, rendering entire landscape in sharp focus from foreground to distant peaks and villages. Lens: 28mm wide-angle lens for epic environmental scale. Genre: Historical landscape cinematography, wartime documentary. Style: Realistic thick-painted 2D animation aesthetic with visible brushstroke quality, strong chiaroscuro with dramatic shadows, low-saturation earth-tone color palette, heavy and oppressive atmosphere. Scene Details: Vast succession of rolling mountain ranges stretching to horizon, multiple overlapping ridge lines creating layered depth, distant villages nestled in valleys at left-center frame, three to four vertical wisps of black smoke rising from villages into grey sky suggesting war's arrival, barely visible winding mountain paths, complex topography of peaks and valleys. Color Palette: Desaturated withered yellow dominating mountain surfaces and autumn grasslands, earth yellow and ochre in rocky terrain, muted browns in sparse vegetation, cool grey overcast sky with heavy clouds, stark black smoke plumes. Lighting Quality: Diffused natural light through thick cloud cover creating even somber illumination, deep shadows in valleys and northern slopes for dramatic contrast, subtle rim lighting on distant peaks, atmospheric haze in far distance. Atmosphere: Heavy, oppressive, solemn, ominous pre-war tension, desolate, grave. Texture: Rough mountain surfaces with thick-painted brushwork texture, weathered rocky terrain, sparse dried autumn vegetation. No characters. Pure environmental establishing shot emphasizing vast isolation before conflict.
